sentences.text: David Michael Hasselhoff -LRB- born July 17 , 1952 -RRB- , nicknamed `` The Hoff '' , is an American actor , singer , producer , and businessman , who set a Guinness World Record as the most watched man on TV .	Guinness World Record	Guinness World Records
He first gained recognition on The Young and The Restless , playing Dr. Snapper Foster .	The Young and The Restless	The Young and The Restless	Snapper Foster	Snapper Foster

His career continued with his leading role as Michael Knight on Knight Rider and as L.A. County Lifeguard Mitch Buchannon in the series Baywatch .	Michael Knight	Michael Knight (Knight Rider)	Knight Rider	Knight Rider (1982 TV series)	Mitch Buchannon	Mitch Buchannon	Baywatch	Baywatch
Hasselhoff produced Baywatch from the 1990s until 2001 when the series ended with Baywatch Hawaii .	Baywatch	Baywatch	Baywatch Hawaii	Baywatch

On screen , he appeared in films including Click , Dodgeball , The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie , and Hop .	Dodgeball	DodgeBall: A True Underdog Story	The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie	The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie	Hop	Hop (film)
In 2000 , he made his Broadway debut in the musical Jekyll & Hyde .	Jekyll & Hyde	Jekyll & Hyde (musical)
Following his debut , he starred in other musicals including Chicago and The Producers .	Chicago	Chicago (musical)	The Producers	The Producers (musical)
